subject: Idea for Wild Florida
body:
Hi,

I came across Wild Florida and spent some time looking through the experience. What stood out most was the combination of the Drive-thru Safari and airboat tours on the same property — the contrast between the slow wide-open safari drive and the speed of an airboat on open Florida water creates an arc that very few outdoor experiences in the state can offer in one visit.

From what I saw, Wild Florida already looks strong, but I think the content could lean more into the scale of the landscape and the transition between the two experiences — so the viewer feels both the vastness and the energy, not just animal highlights.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had would build from the safari drive into the airboat moment, using the Florida landscape to make both feel premium.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for Wild Florida.

Best,
Malachi
